articles.title: A Famous Professor Steps Back After Questions About His Work
articles.summary: Jason Arday, who became Cambridge's youngest Black professor, has canceled a big talk in London. He quit his job after people said he copied others' work and questioned his achievements. He says the attention has been really hard on him and his family.

articles.title: Soldiers in the Capital: Why the National Guard Is Staying in D.C. Until 2029
articles.summary: Imagine seeing soldiers on your walk to school every day. That’s life in Washington, D.C., where 4,600 National Guard troops will stay until 2029. The mission started as a crime emergency but now costs $1.4 billion.

articles.title: This Tiny Idaho Town Is Getting Super-Powered New Reactors — And They Fit on a Truck!
articles.summary: In Atomic City, Idaho (population 52), a startup just flipped the switch on a nuclear reactor small enough to carry on a truck. It could power 1,000 homes and is part of a big push for new, tiny nuclear plants.
